<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex019052026-07-0605-32-05" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo</rs> phyi rol pa dang bgro ba mdzad pa'i dus bzhin du yong ba dad pa'i mthu' su che ba las nye ring med | bar chad kyang pho chung bas ston pa dang seng la gsungs pa bzhin du rang re'i blo ngan skyes pa kho nas byed pas | thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag dang mchod pa bya zhing gsol ba btab na zlogs
               <lb n="6a2"/>pa yin te | de dag gis kun rdzob kyi bden pa la brten nas bskur pa 'debs pa'i mtha' spong ba zhes bya la dbu' ma la 'jug pa zhes byang bya'o || </seg></TEI>
